scope: Host protocol, file-output and GPT safeguards with simulated transports only
checks: matching geometry reports for every planned LUN
supported UFS sector size and capacity
strict numeric range and byte limits
raw-mode entry ACK and terminal raw-mode exit ACK
exact transfer lengths and matching repeated chunk hashes
forbidden XML commands rejected before transport
partial outputs removed and existing outputs not overwritten
device output excluded from public repository paths
saved primary and backup GPT CRC, geometry and overlap validation
limitations: only attaches to an independently established Firehose session
PyUSB backend behavior and real hardware framing remain untested
device-reported geometry is not independent physical measurement
host request restrictions do not establish absence of programmer side effects
chunk repeat matching is not a globally consistent snapshot
read completion is not complete backup or restore proof
